p.72 Outcome 7.2 (Fairness): tests for safety and harms to individuals/groups. Process 7.2.1 Technical Testing, Generative AI: benchmarks, document red-teamer instructions, run benchmarking and red-teaming, stakeholders (owner, product manager, risk team) decide score acceptability; evidence cites tools such as Project Moonshot.

7.1.2 lead-in: 'DOH expects' AI tools to be (7.1.2.2 graceful degradation with automatic alerts; 7.1.2.4 audits/examination by technology provider). 7.2.5 under 'Healthcare End-Users other than Patients shall': regular audits by owning entities, report to DOH as needed. Sec 8: covered entities must comply; DOH may sanction. Policy/AI/0.9, 30 Apr 2018. Mixed expects/shall language supports ambiguous (arguably mandatory for 7.2.5).

4.7(c)-(d) uses 'must' for source-code safeguards (access controls, security), contingency plans for model failure, and ongoing monitoring/review of objectives and inaccuracy, bias, exceptions risk; 'should' for ability/resources to modify or halt the model and for periodic Board/Senior Management review; FSRA 'will' require a process to detect/report programming errors and unexpected outcomes. Document is FSRA guidance under s15(2) FSMR, VER02.061125; guidance status correct.
suggested_fix: Reword: managers must safeguard source code, must have contingency plans and must monitor; should maintain ability to modify/stop the model; FSRA will require error detection/reporting process; Board should periodically review. Keep status guidance.
